provenance.notes: The table is taken from ICU4C release-78.3 (UMALQURA_MONTHLENGTH, UMALQURA_YEAR_START/END). @internationalized/date 3.12.4 is read only to cross-check it (0 differing years). `verification` is measured on Node 22.23.4 (ICU 78.3, CLDR 48.0).

encoding.mask: 12-bit mask as in ICU: bit 11 (0x800) is month 1 … bit 0 is month 12; a set bit means 30 days, a clear bit 29.
encoding.monthLengths: the same information decoded: twelve space-separated day counts, months 1–12.
encoding.startDay: days from the epoch to 1 Muharram of the year (origin 0): Julian day = epochJulianDay + startDay; days since 1970-01-01 = Julian day − unixEpochJulianDay.

icuYearStartFormula.description: ICU does not sum month lengths for the year start; it uses trunc(354.36720·(y−1300) + 460322.05 + 0.5) + umAlQuraYrStartEstimateFix[y−1300]. Compared here with the cumulative sum of the table.

internationalizedDate.description: UMALQURA_DATA (base64, little-endian uint16) and UMALQURA_START_DAYS compared with the ICU masks and the start day of the first year.

verification.against: this table vs Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-u-ca-islamic-umalqura-nu-latn', { timeZone: 'UTC' }), every day
